evals.prompt: I've got cache/apks/uk.co.aifactory.backgammonfree.apk — decompile it into something I can edit and then recompile back into an installable APK, and prove the round-trip is faithful.
evals.expected_output: Decoded smali+resource tree produced; rebuilt+signed APK that passes apksigner verify (v1/v2/v3); verify step shows AndroidManifest IDENTICAL and all smali trees IDENTICAL or content-equivalent; honest explanation that bit-identical is impossible without the original key.

evals.prompt: Change the displayed app name of this Backgammon APK to something custom, rebuild it, and confirm the new name is actually baked into the rebuilt APK.
evals.expected_output: res/values/strings.xml app_name edited; apktool b + sign succeed; aapt2 dump badging on the rebuilt APK shows the new application-label.

evals.prompt: My rebuilt APK won't install — adb says INSTALL_FAILED_UPDATE_INCOMPATIBLE. What's wrong and how do I get it onto my emulator?
evals.expected_output: Explains signature mismatch vs the already-installed (differently-signed) build; instructs adb uninstall <package> then adb install of the debug-signed APK; references troubleshooting.md.

notes: Validated end-to-end on the Backgammon APK 2026-06-25: roundtrip => apksigner verify OK (v1/v2/v3); re-decode diff => manifest + smali IDENTICAL/content-equivalent (only case-insensitive-FS filename suffixes differ); edit-label test => new label present in rebuilt APK badging.
